browser.externalDesc: Sign-in state and history were imported from your everyday Chrome (your original profile is untouched). See below if anything was skipped.

chat.draft1: Walk me through this project: how is it structured, and which files should I read first?
chat.draft2: Help me track down a problem: the symptom is… (add repro steps or the error)
chat.draft3: Review my recent changes: point out risks, gaps, and anything worth improving.
chat.emptyHint: Describe what you want to build, or drop in files — read the code, locate problems, and verify changes together.
chat.forkHere: Branch from here (creates a new branch; the original is kept)
composer.attach: Add images (or just paste / drop them)

composer.keyEnterSend: Enter sends · Shift+Enter for a newline
composer.pathError: Could not read the directory; check project permissions
composer.pathPermission: The current project directory is not readable
composer.phTall: Long-form mode: Enter inserts a newline, Ctrl+Enter sends
composer.resizeExpanded: Long-form: Enter = newline · Ctrl+Enter = send · click to exit
composer.resizeHint: Double-tap ↑ or click here for long-form mode (or drag up)
crash.body: Rendering was interrupted. Your session and everything already on disk are untouched — reload the interface to continue, or copy the details below first.
crash.title: The interface hit an error
ctx.afterCompact: Compacted · refreshes after your next message
ctx.declinedTip: Upstream did not run this compaction (nothing to compact, already compacted, or cancelled by an extension)
ctx.emergencyTip: Compacts unconditionally at {pct}% of the physical window — it ignores the working-set marks and is the last line of defence when that policy fails (or context grows faster than expected). If 90% would eat into the tokens reserved for the reply, the line sits on the reserve boundary instead (so it is not always exactly 90%).
ctx.lastCompactionTip: Cause and result of the last compaction in this run
ctx.nextReached: Working set reached — compacts automatically when this turn ends
ctx.projectIgnoredTip: pi treats a project that has .pi/settings.json as needing trust: unless you run pi in a terminal there and trust it once, the file is ignored entirely. The values shown here are the global ones actually in effect.
ctx.stagePlannedTip: {name} — {what}. There is a mark at {pct}% of the working set, but it only fires once the stage-4 context extension takes over (only "Compact" runs today)
ctx.stageTip: {name} — {what}. Fires at {pct}% of the working set (about {n} tokens)
ctx.stageWhatCompact: compresses the whole conversation into one structured summary, then carries on
ctx.stageWhatFold: folds finished work segments into one conclusion, keeping only decisions and constraints
ctx.stageWhatRecall: brings archived content back into the context on demand
ctx.stageWhatSweep: replaces old tool output with a summary + placeholder; the original history stays in the session file
ctx.stagesTip: The three working-set stages: Sweep replaces old tool output with a summary (70%), Fold turns finished work into a conclusion (85%), Compact compresses the whole conversation (100%). Dashed stages are not wired up yet and will not fire.
ctx.tip:
Used {used} / limit {win} ({pct}%)
Turns amber at 85%, red at 95% — auto-compaction kicks in before it fills
ctx.tipWorkingSet:
Used {used} / working set {cap} ({pct}%) — compacts at the line
Physical window {win} (pi's native compaction line is kept as a fallback)
ctx.workingSetTip: The effective limit derived from min(240k, window×70%, window−reserve−margin); at this line the app asks pi to compact — far earlier than the physical window
detail.actual: Actual response detail for this turn
fp.binaryHint: Use "Show in file manager" or an external app
fp.pdf: PDFs can only be viewed in an external app for now
log.title: Runtime log
mode.foot: Mode differences (tools / prompt / default effort) are not wired up yet — this is the entry point only
mode.title: Mode

ob.footNote: All of this stays available under Settings → Providers / Status

outline.label: Conversation outline

set.alwaysOnTopDesc: When on, the window stays above everything else and will cover other apps. Same switch as the pin button in the title bar
set.ctxCapDesc: Yan compacts once the context reaches this many tokens. Default 240000 (~240k)
set.ctxHint: Leave empty to use the default. Changes apply immediately, no restart
set.ctxModelDesc: Overrides only for {model}; other models keep their own values
set.ctxModelHint: Leave empty and save to remove this model override
set.ctxModelNoModel: No current model yet (available once connected)
set.ctxPresetDesc: The reference preset only changes the cap and window ratio; the stages stay Yan’s three, no extra stages appear
set.ctxRatioDesc: The working set never exceeds this share of the model window. Default 0.7
set.ctxReserveDesc: Space kept for the model answer. Default 32000; small windows are lowered by formula
set.ctxSource.off: Auto compaction is off — the working-set view does not apply
set.densityDesc: Changes spacing only — never font size (Chinese glyphs are pixel-aligned at 12.5px). Standard is identical to before.
set.langDesc: Affects the UI only. Replies and tool output pass through untouched
set.logsDesc: Last {n} lines (extension notices and pi stderr)
set.piBundledMissing: The bundled runtime is missing. Dev: run `npm run vendor:pi`. Installed build: reinstall the app.
set.piShellWarn: Falling back to the shell `pi`; prompts with special characters may break.
set.replayOnboardDesc: Reopen the “Before you start” checklist from first launch (pi / model access / connectivity); does not reset the seen flag
set.sendKeyDesc: How Enter and Ctrl+Enter behave in the composer. "Auto" = Enter sends normally, and inserts a newline in long-form mode (double-tap Up or drag taller). The active rule is always shown in the composer.
set.soundDesc: Alert you when a turn finishes, you are asked to answer, or something errors: play a sound and/or show a system notification when the window is not focused (like opencode's attention)
set.soundEnabledDesc: Master switch. When off, the per-event switches below do nothing
set.soundEventDoneDesc: When a reply completes and the agent stops working
set.soundEventErrorDesc: When the pi process or an extension reports an error
set.soundEventQuestionDesc: When the model or an extension asks you to choose, confirm or type
set.soundNotifyDesc: Shown only when the window is not focused; clicking one brings the window back. Independent from the sound switch
set.soundNotifyTestBody: If you can see this, system notifications work
set.soundVolumeDesc: Releasing the slider previews at the new volume
set.streamWidthDesc: Messages, composer, usage bar and the left navigation rail all share one width; drag to apply instantly
set.themeDesc: Dark is polished; light has full tokens but isn’t fine-tuned
set.title: Settings
set.toolDetailDesc: Off by default: a tool call stays one line — starting, streaming and finishing never expand on their own; click any row to inspect (history always remains readable). On expands only the running call into a terminal window
set.uiScaleDesc: Auto snaps to whole pixels based on your display scaling, so CJK text stays crisp. Also Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0
status.autoCompactHint: Compact history automatically when context is almost full
status.autoRetryHint: Retry automatically on upstream 5xx / rate limit / overload
tl.hint: Sections put in the library disappear from the toolbar; you can always bring them back
tl.open: Tool library: put sections away / bring them back
tl.title: Tool library
tok.cacheTip:
cache read {read} · write {write}
hit rate {hit}% (cache read / total prompt)
tok.elapsedTip: wall-clock time for this turn (includes tool round-trips)
tok.liveTip: This provider reports token usage only at the end, so live tok/s is unavailable. Showing elapsed time instead.
tok.speedTip: generated in {n}s (excludes queueing and tool round-trips)
tok.speedUnknown: no token usage reported for this turn, so speed can't be computed
tool.diffNoPatch: Diff too large — only line counts are shown
tool.diffTooLarge: Larger than 2MB — contents weren't read for a line-by-line diff
tool.notApplied: Not applied — the content below is only what it attempted
tool.wsConcurrent: Another task is running in the same directory — changes in this window can't be attributed to this call (they may include other tasks' or your own edits)
tool.wsNoLine: Contents weren't read — status and size only (so no line counts)
tool.wsTruncated: Directory too large or has unreadable subdirectories — the snapshot is incomplete
tool.wsUnreadable: Working directory was unreadable at the time
